risks.risk: It may be dead/non-repairable or have major faults beyond “needs repair” (e.g., control board, wiring harness, pump, heater, or drum issues).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine being powered on showing any error code/LED display, plus a 1-cycle attempt (wash + drain) with water filling and draining.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / repair required (worst case).

risks.risk: Capacity/variant mismatch (seller says LG; photo shows DirectDrive 6/3kg and 2-in-1 washer+dryer). If the listing is actually different or parts are missing, value changes.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating/model plate (serial/model number) on the back or inside door frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the closest comparable “faulty LG washing machine” category (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (e.g., drain hose, inlet hose, manual, dryer vent/parts for 2-in-1).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included accessories laid out (hoses, power cable, manuals, any dryer-related parts).

risks.risk: Physical damage not obvious from one angle (leaks, bent door, drum damage, corrosion).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of door seal/gasket, bottom corners, and any leak marks; plus a quick tilt/inspection shot of the base.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing repair for leaks/parts (worst case).

proof_requests: Video: power on + error code/LED display, then attempt a full wash cycle (water fill + agitation + drain).
Clear photo of the rating/model/serial plate (back or inside door frame).
Photos of included accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, manuals/warranty/receipt if available).
Close-ups of door seal/gasket and any bottom leak/corrosion areas.
response.reason: The photo identifies an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg front-load washer+dryer style unit, but it does not prove working status; since the seller claims it doesn’t work, the safest pricing is at the worst case (faulty/not working) using the provided faulty/scrap washing-machine comparables.
